title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. This note reports the live paper record as it stands, with no projection. Every position here is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The live starts are v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions

The engine snapshots show 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006. The record also lists a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. These two facts sit side by side in the record: the engine state reads 0 open positions, while the trade note says the NEAR entry remains open. No position size, margin, or unrealized figure is given, so none is reported here. Because the record is paper only, an open position is a tracked signal rather than an exposure to capital. A paper position is tracked from entry to exit using the same rules as a live signal, but no order is sent. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so its outcome is not yet in the closed-trade averages.

## Closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 has 5 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. The most recent closed trade described in the record is ATOM: it entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703. That result is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The averages are small-sample measurements from closed paper trades, not estimates of future results. The 5, 6, and 7 closed-trade counts are small, so the averages can move sharply with one more trade. The ATOM exit below its 10-day low at 1.703 is one observation; it does not establish an expected return. The null average for htf-rsi-v007 means the record does not show a numeric net average for those 5 trades; it is reported exactly as null. A negative average such as -13.22% means the average closed paper trade in that sample ended below its entry after costs.

## Market filter

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both trend engines also show 0 positions open on paper in the same snapshot. The record does not explain why the filter is off or what price condition would turn it on, so no cause is assigned here. The filter state is reported as a current reading, alongside the position count and the closed-trade averages. The phrase "off" is the engine's own state label. With the filter off, the record still shows 0 positions open on paper for both trend engines, and that coexistence is reported as it appears rather than as a causal claim.

## Distance to the 20-day breakout

For trend-daily-v005, the symbols closest to their 20-day breakout are TRXUSDT at 12.57% below its high, AAVEUSDT at 16.30% below its high, and XLMUSDT at 17.87% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, the symbols closest to their 20-day breakout are JUPUSDT at 6.80% below its high, TRXUSDT at 12.57% below its high, and AAVEUSDT at 16.30% below its high. These figures describe how far each symbol sits below its high at the snapshot time. They are measurements of distance, not signals to enter or exit, and they carry no prediction about whether a breakout will occur. The list is limited to the three symbols closest to the level for each engine. Each percentage is a distance from the high, not a forecast of direction or timing.

## Snapshot and where to check

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-18T21:22:34.203Z. The record updates continuously, so counts, averages, and distances can change as new closes arrive. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Because every entry here is paper, a change in the record reflects a change in tracked signals, not a change in capital at risk. Readers can compare the article's figures with the performance page and signal log because the same numbers appear in all three places. The status posted to the channel is another place where the same numbers appear.
